summary: Clone Activities functionality testing completed successfully. All backend tests passed (13/13). Frontend UI testing confirmed CloneActivityModal works in FORO, MATERIAL, and EXÁMENES tabs. Cloned items show correct status (active/published, not draft) and appear with '(copia)' suffix.
seed_data_creation: Test forums, materials, and exams created with TEST_ prefix during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clone functionality for Forums, Materials, and Exams is fully working. Backend endpoints POST /api/course/posts/{post_id}/clonar and POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/clonar return {clonados: int, errores: []}. Frontend CloneActivityModal opens correctly in all 3 tabs (FORO, MATERIAL, EXÁMENES) with tree structure (Nivel → Grado → Sección → Asignatura). Cloned items inherit status from original (active/published, not draft).
verified_features: POST /api/course/posts/{post_id}/clonar - Clone forum/material to same section (clonar_en_misma_seccion=true)
POST /api/course/posts/{post_id}/clonar - Clone forum/material to other subjects (destinos list)
POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/clonar - Clone exam to same section
POST /api/exams/{exam_id}/clonar - Clone exam to other subjects
Status inheritance: clones get 'active'/'published' status (not draft)
Tree structure (Nivel → Grado → Sección → Asignatura) loads correctly
